    collapseStringToInt(String) - Method in class org.troy.capstone.data_structures.ItemTable.IdHashKey
    Algorithm source is https://www.tutorialspoint.com/data_structures_algorithms/rabin_karp_algorithm.htm Rabin-Karp style string to int collapse, using polynomial rolling hash method Pre-Conditions: str is not null and only contains ASCII characters from '!' to '~' (printable characters excluding space and delete)
